spans.s:
अशोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Cheerful, not sorrowful.
 m. (-कः) A tree com-
monly Asoka (Jonesia Asoca.)
 n. (-कं) Quicksilver.
 f. (-का)
 1. A
medicinal plant, see कटुकी.
 2. One of the female domestic deities
of the jainas.
 E. अ neg. and शोक sorrow.

अशोकरोहिणी f. (-णी) A medicinal plant, see कटुकी.
 E. अशोक, and रोहिणी
the same.

अशोकारि m. (-रिः) A tree, (Nauclea Cadamba:) see कदम्ब.
 E. अशोक, and
अरि an enemy: choking the Asoca.

अशोच m. (-चः) Content, tranquillity, the absence of care or vanity.
 E. अ
priv. शोच sorrow.

अशोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) Not to be sorrowed for.
 E. अ neg. शोच्य to be
regretted; also अशोचनीय and अशोचितव्य.

. Inaccuracy.
 E. अ neg. शोधन cleaning,
&c.

अशोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Unclean, uncleansed.
 2. Inaccurate, unrevised,
uncorrected.
 E. अ neg. शोधित purified.

अशोष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Not to be dried up.
 E. अ neg. शोष्य to be dried
up; so अशोषणीय, &c.
